name: annotation-summary-group
title: AnnotationSummaryGroup
description: Collapsible group showing aggregate stats over a list of annotation values for one AnnotationConfig. Reuses the AnnotationConfig contract and dispatches on config.type: continuous -> mean of the finite numeric values + count; categorical -> count per option label + total count; freeform -> count of non-empty values. Controlled and pure -- the consumer owns values; this component only summarizes. Native details/summary for zero-JS collapsibility; composes Card/Badge.
